# American Airlines Cargo

> American Airlines Cargo provides comprehensive air freight and cargo shipping services with digital booking platforms, rate calculators, and specialized logistics solutions.

American Airlines Cargo is the cargo division of American Airlines Group, offering air freight services across domestic and international networks. The site features pricing tools, booking platforms, operational updates, and news about cargo service expansions, facility developments, and industry recognition.

## Key Topics

- air freight
- cargo shipping
- rate calculator
- cargo pricing
- WebCargo platform
- digital booking
- widebody schedule
- international routes
- life sciences logistics
- pharmaceutical transport
- cargo operations
- eAWB (electronic air waybill)
- freight forwarding
- Miami hub
- Dallas-Fort Worth hub

## Pricing & Booking Tools

- [American Airlines Cargo - Air Freight, Cargo Shipping, and Air Shipping Services](https://www.aacargo.com/AACargo/rateCalculator): Rate calculator tool for Priority Parcel Service air freight pricing and cost estimation

## Digital Platform Expansion

- [American Airlines Cargo expands WebCargo bookings to include U.S. network](https://www.aacargo.com/about/AA_expands_webcargo_US_origins.html): WebCargo platform expansion to US network via Freightos partnership for digital cargo booking

## Service Expansion & Operations

- [American Airlines Cargo Announces Winter Widebody Schedule](https://www.aacargo.com/about/American_Airlines_Cargo_Announces_Winter_Widebody_Schedule.html): Winter widebody schedule expansion with new US stations and life sciences focus
- [American Airlines Cargo Expands International Winter Widebody Schedule](https://www.aacargo.com/about/American_Airlines_Cargo_Expands_International_Winter_Widebody_Schedule.html): Trans-Atlantic widebody flight expansion and international route announcements
- [New daily San Juan-Philadelphia widebody service for pharmaceutical logistics](https://www.aacargo.com/about/update_04Apr2017.html): Daily San Juan-Philadelphia widebody service launch for pharmaceutical and life sciences cargo
- [American shows off new Milan facility - American Airlines Cargo](https://www.aacargo.com/about/cargo-shows-off-new-milan-facility.html): New Milan cargo facility opening at Malpensa Airport with expanded capacity

## Leadership & Policy

## Awards & Recognition
